drafts.shaka: Serially initialize new players and finish obsolete player's destruction before another player attaches same video. Refuse new initialization after cleanup fails because ownership is uncertain. Arm session snapshot on loading, consume once at unloading or explicit disposal, and capture before removing listeners, including reentrant/callback failures. Preserve shared disposal identity. Normalize primitive/null/undefined cleanup errors to safe default. QoE queue exposes local bounded eviction and sendfailure counters plus pending depth/inflight status; callback failures must not change queue behavior, raw errors or records never diagnostics. Consumers map only to registered metrics, no new names/thresholds.
